lines: +cd /tmp; rm -rf facts2; mkdir facts2; cd facts2
+git init -q -b main r; cd r; git config user.email a@test; git config user.name A
+mkdir -p a/b; echo x>a/b/f; git add .; git commit -qm base
+tree=$(git write-tree); subtree=$(git ls-tree $tree a | awk '{print $3}'); subsub=$(git ls-tree $subtree b | awk '{print $3}')
+for o in $tree $subtree $subsub $blob; do grep -q $o /tmp/facts2/indexed.txt && echo "$o yes" || echo "$o NO"; done
+# expire reflogs then repack -a -d prune; check cache-tree objects
+for o in $tree $subtree $subsub $blob; do git cat-file -t $o >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "$o retained $(git cat-file -t $o)" || echo "$o GONE"; done
+git init -q -b main w; cd w; git config user.email a@test; git config user.name A; echo x>f; git add f; git commit -qm base
+cd ../w2; echo sidefile>only-w2.txt; git add only-w2.txt; wblob=$(git ls-files --stage only-w2.txt|awk '{print $2}')
+echo other>oo.txt; git add oo.txt; git commit -qm sidecommit; sidecommit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
+echo "main rev-list --all includes sidecommit?"; git rev-list --all | grep -q $sidecommit && echo yes-branch-ref || echo no
+# side is branch ref so included anyway. Make detached worktree with commit not on any branch:
+cd ../w3; echo detached>d.txt; git add d.txt; dblob=$(git ls-files --stage d.txt|awk '{print $2}'); git commit -qm detachedcommit; dcommit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
+echo staged-only-after-commit > s.txt; git add s.txt; sblob=$(git ls-files --stage s.txt|awk '{print $2}')
+echo "main --indexed-objects contains w3 staged blob?"; git rev-list --objects --indexed-objects --all | grep -q $sblob && echo yes || echo NO
+# note reflog expire --all from main does it affect w3 HEAD log?
+echo "w3 reflog:"; git -C ../w3 reflog || true; ls -R .git/logs .git/worktrees 2>&1 | head -n 100
+for o in $wblob $sidecommit $dcommit $dblob $sblob; do git cat-file -t $o >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "$o retained" || echo "$o GONE"; done
+git init -q -b main src; cd src; git config user.email a@test; git config user.name A; echo one>f; git add f; git commit -qm one; echo two>f; git commit -qam two
+cd ..; git clone -q --shared src alt; cd alt
+# delete future by reset local branch to first commit, keep reflog expire
+first=$(git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD); git reset -q --hard $first; git reflog expire --expire=now --all
+git prune --expire=now; echo prune:$?; git log --oneline; git fsck --full; echo fsck:$?; git count-objects -v
+git clone -q --depth 1 file://$PWD/src shal; cd shal; echo shallow-file:; cat .git/shallow; git log --oneline; git count-objects -v

+git reflog expire --expire=now --all; git repack -a -d -q; echo repack:$?; git prune --expire=now; echo prune:$?; git log --oneline; git fsck --full; echo fsck:$?; ls .git/shallow && cat .git/shallow
